summary.text: Terry Carlson is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 19-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Joel McEntire (R).
He ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Terry Carlson was born in Everett, Washington, and graduated from Granite Falls High School.
He earned an associate degree from Lower Columbia College in 2021 and a bachelor's degree from Washington State University in 2023, and has served as vice president of his local labor council.
In the 2024 general election for District 19-Position 2, Carlson lost to McEntire, 62.2 percent to 37.7 percent.
